description: Open a feedback form for the person, prefilled with your draft, so they can report a problem or suggest an improvement to this ABS connector — or flag something wrong in ABS's own data. Use it whenever the person wants to give feedback, or agrees when you offer after something went wrong. Fill in what you know from the conversation: kind, a one-line summary in their words, details, and the tool, table, selection and error involved. Never include personal information about anyone, and never fill in a contact email the person did not give you. This tool sends nothing: on hosts that show interactive views the person reviews, edits and sends the form themselves; elsewhere, follow the `next` field.

about.description: connector: this connector or its site; abs: ABS's own data or API (so it can be passed on to ABS)

assistant.description: The AI tool in use, e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot

contact.description: Only if the person chose to give an email address for a reply. Never guess or fill one in.

details.description: What happened and what was expected. No personal information about anyone.

error.description: The error reason or message returned, if any

kind.description: bug: something broke; data: a figure or label looks wrong; missing: an expected table or option is absent; idea: an improvement; docs: unclear guidance; praise: it worked well; other

selection.description: The selection or query involved, as JSON or the SDMX key

shareWithAbs.description: Only true if the person agreed this may be passed on to ABS, contact address included

summary.description: One line, in the person's own words

table.description: The ABS table id involved, e.g. CPI
